signals.label: Countries with significant internet outages (48 h)
signals.note: Armenia, Congo, Haiti, Honduras, Iraq, Lithuania, Norfolk Island, Papua New Guinea, Saint Martin, Sao Tome And Principe, Tonga, Tunisia
signals.means: More countries with large internet outages may mean shutdowns, attacks on networks or grid failures.
signals.not_proves: It does not tell the cause: cable cuts, power cuts and censorship all look alike here.

signals.label: Kyiv City: networks answering internet probes, % of their 7-day norm (a dip = power cuts)
signals.note: today so far (2026-10-09); day before 93.54%. Generators and batteries hide part of a blackout; a dip can also be a network fault or a lasting change in what IODA probes (Kyiv City stepped down 4% on 23 Sep and stayed)
signals.series_kind: daily mean of responsive /24 blocks, % of the median of the 7 days before
signals.means: Fewer networks in a region answering internet probes than in the week before usually means power cuts: on 7-8 Oct 2026, when Kyiv had emergency cuts, Kyiv City fell to 94-97% while Lviv stayed within 3%.
signals.not_proves: It does not measure the blackout itself: generators and batteries hide part of it, and a network fault or a change in what is probed looks the same.

signals.label: Yandex Cloud: open incidents on its public status page
signals.note: Нарушение электропитания в зоне доступности ru-central-b (open 48 h, level 2); longest open 48 h
signals.means: An incident that stays open for days on Yandex Cloud, the cloud many Russian services and shutdown whitelists depend on, means physical damage is not repaired (after the 7-8 Oct Sasovo strike a power incident in zone ru-central1-b stayed open).
signals.not_proves: It does not tell the cause: most incidents are ordinary faults, and the company decides what it publishes.

signals.label: US "Do Not Travel" (Level 4) countries
signals.means: A new country on the US Level 4 list means the US government sees a sharp rise in danger there.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove danger: advisories are political and change slowly.

signals.label: Shallow M4.5+ events near nuclear test sites (7 days)
signals.means: A shallow quake near a nuclear test site could be a nuclear or large conventional test.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove a test: natural quakes happen there; only CTBTO or seismologists can tell.

signals.label: FAO Food Price Index (2026-09)
signals.note: baseline = same month a year ago
signals.means: Higher world food prices raise the risk of unrest in import-dependent poor countries.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove unrest: prices follow harvests, weather and currencies.

signals.label: Satellite fire detections near major refineries/oil terminals, European Russia (last 3 days)
signals.note: 13 sites, data to 2026-10-08
signals.series_kind: daily count of VIIRS fire detections within ~15 km of the sites (incl. routine gas flares)
signals.means: More satellite fire detections near big refineries may mean strikes, sabotage or accidents at energy sites.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove an attack or the site hit: gas flaring, field burning and accidents also show as fires.

signals.label: Russia: presidential acts on call-up, mobilisation, reserves, military registration or exit (last 30 days)
signals.note: 2026-09-28 Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 28.09.2026 № 700 "Об установлении штатной численности Вооруженных Сил
signals.series_kind: matching acts per publication day (days with none omitted)
signals.means: More official acts on call-up, reserves, military registration or exit rules means the state is changing how it raises soldiers.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove mobilisation: since 2026 conscription runs all year under one December decree, staffing decrees (the authorised size of the armed forces) come every year or two, and many acts are technical.

signals.label: Russia: open contract-service vacancies on the official job portal (Работа России)
signals.note: top regions: Калужская область 207, Мурманская область 179, Костромская область 179, Кабардино-Балкарская Республика 129, Новосибирская область 107
signals.means: More ads for contract soldiers means the state needs more men than volunteers bring in.
signals.not_proves: Ads are re-posted and padded; a count is not recruits, and a fall can mean a new channel, not less need.

signals.label: Russia: contract-service vacancies posted in the last 7 days
signals.means: A surge of new ads is a recruiting push, often before or instead of coercion.
signals.not_proves: Regional campaigns are seasonal and budget-driven.

signals.label: Russia: median advertised monthly pay for contract service
signals.note: 127 regional centres/cities (contractarmy.ru table, recruiter-maintained, unverified): regional sign-up payout median 2.10M RUB, max 4.1M (Санкт-Петербург 4.1M, Магадан 3.6M, Махачкала 3.5M); 74 at 2M+; newest act date cited 2026-10-01
signals.means: Rising pay means volunteers are getting scarcer at the old price.
signals.not_proves: Ads show the headline, not what is paid; inflation lifts all wages.

signals.means: A rising premium means people pay extra to move money out of roubles: a classic sign of fear of leaving or of controls.
signals.not_proves: Crypto spreads also move with exchange rules, bank blocks and fees.

signals.label: Rouble: official dollar rate (CBR)
signals.means: A sharp fall of the rouble often accompanies capital flight and panic.
signals.not_proves: The rate is managed and moves with oil and policy rates.

signals.not_proves: News is chosen by the Duma press service; one session day can produce several items on one law.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: longest daily waiting time for cars heading into Russia (Koidula/Luhamaa, GoSwift)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 333 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 41 d; Luhamaa 326 cars queued; max car wait 155 h on 2026-10-08
signals.means: A sudden jump means the Russian side is processing travellers slowly or more people are crossing: friction at Russia's western land border.
signals.not_proves: Direction is into Russia, not out of it; holidays, Russian checks and staffing move it. Not a count of people leaving Russia. The site does not state the unit; hours is inferred.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: 7-day mean of the daily maximum car waiting time (GoSwift)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 333 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 41 d; Luhamaa 326 cars queued; max car wait 155 h on 2026-10-08
signals.means: A sustained rise in waiting time is a slower, steadier sign of tighter Russian border control or heavier traffic.
signals.not_proves: Seasonal travel and Russian processing capacity dominate; not specific to mobilisation.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: days until the first free car reservation slot (GoSwift)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 333 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 41 d; Luhamaa 326 cars queued; max car wait 155 h on 2026-10-08
signals.means: When pre-booked slots run weeks ahead, demand to cross far exceeds what the Russian side lets through.
signals.not_proves: Slot horizons depend on how much capacity the system opens for booking.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: cars in the full GoSwift queue (live + booked)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 333 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 41 d; Luhamaa 326 cars queued; max car wait 155 h on 2026-10-08
signals.means: More cars queued means more demand to cross into Russia or slower processing.
signals.not_proves: Booked queue includes reservations weeks ahead.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: cars let through per day, 7-day mean (GoSwift)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 333 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 41 d; Luhamaa 326 cars queued; max car wait 155 h on 2026-10-08
signals.means: A collapse in throughput with a growing queue means the Russian side is slowing or closing the crossing.
signals.not_proves: Low throughput can be a technical or staffing issue.

signals.not_proves: Quarterly and survey-weighted; mostly tourism and family visits; arrives a month or more after the quarter.

signals.label: Russian garrison courts (panel): new cases of unauthorised leaving of a unit (art. 337), last 28 days, per court
signals.note: 4/16 garrison courts, cases received 2026-09-11..2026-10-08: art.337 64, art.338 0; largest: moskovskygvs.msk 31, gvs.wlk 17, gvs.nvg 9; no answer: 235gvs.msk TimeoutError, chgvs.chel TimeoutError, mgvs.chel TimeoutError, novocherkasskygvs.ros TimeoutError
signals.source: garrison military courts (sudrf.ru), panel of courts without captcha

signals.not_proves: Court cards appear with delays and many cases are hidden or never opened (deserters are often sent back to the front instead); a panel of large courts, not all of Russia.
